context_requirements: PDGFRA expression or PDGF ligand autocrine/paracrine signaling
mesenchymal or fibroblast-like lineage with active PDGFR-driven transcriptional program
absence of strong redundant RTK signaling that bypasses PDGFR inhibition
falsifiers: No change in any PDGFR-associated immediate early gene (EGR1, FOS, JUN, MYC) at 6 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
Strong and consistent upregulation of PDGFRA target genes across all nine lines

changes: Moved EGR1, FOS, JUN, MYC, CCND1, FOSL1, IER3, ATF5, CEBPD, DUSP6, ETV1, FOXO3, GADD45B, ID2 from proximal_up to late_up because PDGFR inhibition does not directly induce these genes; any upregulation is secondary and delayed.

Moved PDGFA, COL1A1, COL4A1, MMP1, MMP2, TIMP2, SERPINE1, TGFB3, EDN1, SPP1, LOXL1, P4HA2, PLOD3, LAMA3, ITGB5 from proximal_down to late_down because loss of PDGFR signaling reduces their transcription only after downstream pathway shutdown.
Removed GADD45B, DUSP6, ETV1, FOXO3, IER3, ATF5 from late_up because they are generic stress or proliferation genes, not specific PDGFR targets.
Removed CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, MCM3, PCNA, MYBL2, UBE2C, KIF20A from late_down because they are generic proliferation genes and belong in generic_effects.
Changed kinetics from slow to intermediate because PDGFR inhibition affects immediate early genes within 6 h and cell-cycle genes by 24 h.
Changed magnitude 6h from weak to moderate because immediate early gene changes are detectable at 6 h.
Changed magnitude 24h from moderate to strong because cell-cycle arrest and differentiation marker changes are pronounced at 24 h.
Changed line_response for A375, A549, HCC515, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP from weak to none because these lines lack PDGFRA expression or PDGFR-driven autocrine loops.
Changed line_response for HA1E and HEPG2 from none to weak because they may express PDGFRA and show some response.
Removed evidence list because no citations were provided.
